metadata.name: adaptive-config-fixture
metadata.description: Schema fixture: every config field the parser reads. rel_tol, abs_tol, h_min and h_max are consumed by GSSK_StepAdaptive and emitted by GSSK_SerializeModel, but no example sets them, so nothing noticed when the schema stopped describing them.

_covers: config.rel_tol, config.abs_tol, config.h_min, config.h_max — parsed at src/gssk.c GSSK_Init, serialised at build_model_json.
